title: Capture-lifetime follow-ups: settle refused captures, own the post-serve join, keep the 40 s join off the async shutdown future
outcome: A refused capture spawn reads as failed rather than still running; main's post-serve capture join no longer depends on trigger_shutdown_signal having run first; and the graceful-shutdown future does not block a tokio worker for up to 40 s.
acceptance: EngramCapture::spawn settles a capture whose lifetime spawn is refused with an explicit failure, so open_to_writes() does not stay true and the check can fence, with a regression test
main.rs's post-serve capture join runs retire_capture_observation_workers (or trigger_shutdown_signal) first and uses the stop_and_join result
trigger_shutdown_signal only stops the captures, keeping the fencing order, and the blocking join runs in main's post-serve path or under spawn_blocking
